---
title: "05 - Linear Regression"
format: html
---

## Library Loading

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(broom)
```

## Load Data

```{r}
dat_aug <- read_tsv(file = here("data/03_dat_aug_inner.tsv"))
```

## Analysis

```{r}
mortality_model <- dat_aug |>
  lm(formula = mortality_rate ~ measles_coverage + stunting_prevalence,
     data = _)
```

## Coefficients

```{r}
mortality_model |>
  pluck("coefficients")
```

## Tidy the model

```{r}
mortality_model_tidy <- mortality_model |>
  tidy(conf.int = TRUE,
       conf.level = 0.95)
 
mortality_model_tidy
```

## Summary stats

```{r}
mortality_model_glance <- mortality_model |>
  glance()
 
mortality_model_glance
```

## Check significance

```{r}
mortality_model |>
  summary()
```

## Visualise

```{r}
mortality_coef_plot <- mortality_model_tidy |>
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = estimate,
             y = fct_reorder(term, estimate),
             xmin = conf.low,
             xmax = conf.high)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0) +
  geom_errorbarh() +
  geom_point() +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 1)) +
  labs(x = "Estimates (95%CIs)",
       y = "",
       title = "Measles Vaccination Coverage and Stunting Prevalence\nAssociated with Under-Five Mortality",
       caption = "Data from WHO Global Health Observatory (GHO)")

mortality_coef_plot
```

## Store Results

```{r}
ggsave(filename = here("results/05_key_plot_1.png"),
       plot = mortality_coef_plot,
       width = 7,
       height = 4,
       dpi = 300,
       bg = )
```
